# APATERO

> > APATERO is an AI image and video generation platform offering 200+ creation realms with Sora, Midjourney, Flux, and 50+ models, featuring uncensored content generation and commercial licensing.

The platform provides tools for creating AI influencers, face swaps, and style-specific content (Ghibli, Pixar, GTA, Minecraft). It supports crypto payments, offers a 7-day free trial, and runs an affiliate program with 20-30% commission.

## Key Topics

- AI image generation
- AI video generation
- Sora
- Midjourney
- Flux
- LoRa models
- Uncensored AI
- Virtual influencers
- Face swap technology
- Commercial licensing
- Crypto payments
- ComfyUI workflows
- NSFW content generation
- Ghibli and Pixar styles
- AI monetization
